title: Unique exact multiplier in the complete numerator-safe nonnegative design space

design_space.definition: All nonnegative multipliers for which M*a + 2^25 fits signed int32_t for every int16_t a.

properties.claim: Every multiplier in 0..64513 has a signed-int32-representable numerator for every int16_t input, and wide and int32 arithmetic-right-shift results agree.
Multiplier 20159 implements exact centered reduction for every int16_t input and agrees with the real frozen production function.
Every multiplier in 0..20158 is rejected by witness a=-31626.
Every multiplier in 20160..64513 is rejected by witness a=-31625.
Within the design space, passing both adjacent witnesses is equivalent to multiplier=20159.

input_domains.multiplier: all int32 values, with the design domain encoded by logical implications

portability_scope: Signed right shift follows the semantics represented by the recorded CBMC environment.
